paite: Oded tapa Azariah tung ah Pathian kha ahong tung hi.
heading: Asa Kipuahthakna Thilhihte
english: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

paite: Asa dawn ding in apaikhia a, akiang ah, "Asa leh Judah mi tengteng leh Benjamin mite aw, ka thu ngaikhe dih ua, alam a na pan sung teng un nou lam ah TOUPA apang, amah na zon uleh na mu ding ua, amah na lehngatsan uleh ama'n ahon lehngatsan ding.
english: He went out to meet Asa, and said to him, “Hear me, Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin! Yahweh is with you while you are with him; and if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

paite: Israel mite sawtpi Pathian tak nei lou leh sinsakmi leh siampu nei lou leh dan nei lou in a-om uhi.
english: Now for a long time Israel was without the true God, without a teaching priest, and without law.

paite: Himahleh, amangbat ua TOUPA Israel' Pathian lam angat ua, azontak un amu uhi.
english: But when in their distress they turned to Yahweh, the God of Israel, and sought him, he was found by them.

paite: Huai lai in apawt lam leh alut lamte a ding in galmuanna a-om kei a, gamsung a om tengteng a ding in mangbatna thupi mahmah ngen ahi zaw.
english: In those times there was no peace to him who went out, nor to him who came in; but great troubles were on all the inhabitants of the lands.

paite: Nam leh nam, khua leh khua akihihsia ua, Pathian in haksatna chiteng in ahaksasak hi.
english: They were broken in pieces, nation against nation, and city against city; for God troubled them with all adversity.

paite: Himahleh, nou zaw hattak in om unla, kithadahsak kei un, na thilhih man uh na mu ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will be rewarded.”

paite: Huchi in Asa in huai thute leh zawlnei Oded thugente azak in akihangsak a, Judah gam leh Benjamin gam tengteng a kipan leh Ephraim tanggam a kholak a kipan athilkihhuaite apaimang vek a; TOUPA' inn lim chin a TOUPA maitam abawlhoih hi.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed Yahweh’s altar that was before Yahweh’s porch.

paite: udah gam leh Benjamin gammi tengteng, akiang a om Ephraim leh Manasseh leh Simeon gam a mite toh asamkhawm vek a, TOUPA Pathian akiang ah a-om chih atheih un Israel gam a pan in ahong bel vek uhi.
english: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that Yahweh his God was with him.

paite: Huchi in Asa vaihawm akum sawm leh kum nga, akha thumna ah Jerusalem ah akikaikhawm uhi.
english: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.

paite: Huai ni in agallak uh bawngtal zasagih leh belam sangsagih in TOUPA kiang ah akithoih uhi.
english: They sacrificed to Yahweh in that day, from the plunder which they had brought, seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep.

paite: Alungsim uh leh alungtang tengteng un TOUPA apipute uh Pathian zong ding leh;
english: They entered into the covenant to seek Yahweh, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and with all their soul;

paite: kuapeuh TOUPA Israel' Pathian zong lou aneu leh alian, anumei apasal in hihlup ding thu akhung uhi.
english: and that whoever would not seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah aw ngaihtak a ging in, akikou ua, pengkul ging toh, pengkul binei ging toh akichiam uhi.
english: They swore to Yahweh with a loud voice, with shouting, with trumpets, and with cornets.

paite: Judah mi tengteng akichiamna uah akipak ua, alungtangtak ua kichiam a, kituaktak a ahih ziak un, muh leng amu him ua; huchi in TOUPA'N mun chih ah galmuang a omna apia hi.
english: All Judah rejoiced at the oath, for they had sworn with all their heart and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found by them. Then Yahweh gave them rest all around.

paite: Kumpipa Asa nu Maakah leng milim kihhuaitak Asherah abawlsak ziak in akumpinu hihna atawpsak a; huchi in Asa in milim aphuk a, ahihzan vek a, Kidron lui ah ahal hi.
english: Also Maacah, the mother of Asa the king, he removed from being queen mother, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah; so Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust, and burned it at the brook Kidron.

paite: Himahleh, Israel gam a kipan mun sangte paihmang ahi kei a; himahleh Asa lungsim avaihawm sung in akizen gige hi.
english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

paite: Apa thillatte leh ama latte dangkasik, dangka-eng, tui-um belsuan Pathian inn ah alalut hi.
english: He brought the things that his father had dedicated and that he himself had dedicated, silver, gold, and vessels into God’s house.

paite: Asa vaihawm lai kum sawmthum-le-nga sung in kidou himhim a-om nawn kei hi.
english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.
